name: Darius DB (Lite Version 0.1.3)
author: Darius Cumpio
announcement: Darius DB (Lite Version 0.1.3) — Local + Cloud Database Manager! Fixed MS SQL Server Msg 273 timestamp/rowversion & IDENTITY sync/export errors, added 0%–100% progress loading for Backup & Sync, plus SQL Pagination!
changelog: Fixed MS SQL Server Sync & Export (Msg 273 / Msg 544): excludes timestamp/rowversion and computed columns from INSERT, preserves IDENTITY(1,1) with SET IDENTITY_INSERT ON/OFF, encodes varbinary as hex (0x...), adds FK-safe refresh on Sync, suppresses '(N rows affected)' noise with SET NOCOUNT ON, and makes error logs scrollable

Added Live Percentage Progress Loading to Database Backup & Export (.zip, .sql, .csv, .bak): shows real-time 0%–100% progress bar, per-table CSV count, SQL dump size, and .zip packaging status across Cloud Cards and Database Tab
Added Live Percentage Progress Bar to Local ↔ Cloud Sync: displays real-time 0%–100% progress bar, table count, exported byte size, elapsed time, and completion/error status during push/pull sync

Fixed Cloud & Sync Modal UI Layout: set explicit modal widths so max-width wasn't capped at 410px, constrained grid inputs/selects with minmax(0, 1fr) so long Cloud Profile hostnames never clip Cloud Database inputs, and added backdrop blur

Added SQL Results Pagination: configurable page sizes (50, 100, 250, 500, 1000, 5000, 10000, and Max/All), First/Prev/Page Numbers/Next/Last + page jump controls, automatic LIMIT/TOP expansion, and up to 250,000-row Max cap
Fixed post-update reboot crash/no-display: prevented NewManagerWithOptions(skipAdopt=true) from triggering emitStatus() before a.mgr was assigned, and added nil guard in App.emitStatus

Added 📦 Full Database Backup Archive (.zip): 1-click export containing full .sql dump, per-table UTF-8 .csv spreadsheets, and manifest.json for Local & Cloud databases (cPanel, MonsterASP.NET, etc.), plus .zip Import/Restore

Fixed PostgreSQL & StopAll Shutdown: added killProcessTree for child worker processes, pg_ctl -m immediate fallback, cancellable Prepare/Start wait, and autoStartServices=false on update reboot so Apache & Mailpit stay OFF until clicked

Added ☁️ Cloud Database System: connect cPanel (MySQL/Postgres), MonsterASP.NET / SmarterASP (MS SQL Server), Supabase, Neon, Aiven, TiDB, AWS RDS, Azure & Redis Cloud with TLS, URI/ADO.NET parser, live Test Ping, full SQL/Redis browser + CRUD, and 1-Click Local ↔ Cloud Sync

Dashboard Service Controls: Updates now stop all running engines beforehand, reboot with all Dashboard switches OFF (--all-off), clear stale 'process exited' messages, and let you cancel stuck 'starting' services with a click or Stop All
Fixed PostgreSQL custom-format dump import (auto-detects PGDMP/tar/dir dumps via pg_restore --no-owner --no-acl even when named .sql)
Fixed Auto-Updater visible reboot (--show --updated + ForceShowWindow + live main Setup binary priority) and improved Check Online build comparison

Performance Optimization: Parallel service status/adoption checks, SQL connection pooling, cached system MSSQL/PHP detection, zero-write settings checks, fast service readiness polling, debounced row filtering, and chunked Show All table rendering
Added Database Import (.sql, .csv, .bak) and Full CRUD (Create Row, Create Table, Show Details, Edit Row, Delete, Show All)
Added Single-Table, Selected-Tables, and Full-Database Export (.sql with Structure/Data toggles & .csv)
Added 1-Click GitHub System Updater with BuildID tracking, automatic update download, and automatic app restart
Added standalone DariusDB-Updater.exe and bundled Installer, Launcher, Uninstaller & Updater executables on GitHub
Fixed MySQL Error 1130 on 127.0.0.1, removed username/password from mssql.conf, and auto-provisioned sqlcmd.exe
Separated MariaDB and MySQL rows/tabs and redesigned Dashboard with Toggle-Switch rows & Full-Stack guide
Hardened PHP (Zend OPcache, PDO utf8mb4, secure sessions), Apache security headers, and MariaDB/MySQL InnoDB 256M configs
